summary: Vtable entry getter: reads the vtable pointer stored at this+0x0, then returns the dword stored at vtable offset +0xC (the fourth vtable slot, a virtual function pointer). No calls, guards, globals, or side effects; the thunk only resolves and returns the vtable entry.

local_names.vtable: vtable pointer read from this+0x0; the entry at offset +0xC is returned

operations.description: Read the vtable pointer from this+0x0.
Read the dword at vtable offset +0xC (fourth vtable slot) from the object reached through this+0x0.
Return the dword read from vtable offset +0xC as the function result.

unresolved: Whether the returned value is a virtual function pointer to be invoked elsewhere or a data value stored in the vtable region is not evidenced.
The owner class and the identity of the virtual method at vtable slot +0xC are unknown.
